latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Subtitle Generator Chrome Extension.

- Instantly generates and adds AI-powered subtitles to uploaded video files (MP4, MOV, WebM, AVI up to 500MB)
- Simple setup: automatic token and session management; supports anonymous sign-in with free credits
- Download 1080p MP4 videos with burned-in captions in ~30–90 seconds  
- Handles user prompts for uploads, exports, credits, and editing with smart intent matching
- All processing done via secure cloud backend; no desktop software required
- Provides detailed error handling and progress updates throughout the workflow
